headline: BJP Rajya Sabha Member Ramrao Wadkute Dies From Cardiac Arrest
seoTitle: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute Dies
metaDescription: BJP Rajya Sabha member Ramrao Wadkute has passed away in Delhi due to a cardiac arrest. He was elected to the upper house earlier this year in April.
aiSummaryBullets: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute has passed away at the age of sixty-two.
Medical reports indicate the cause of death was cardiac arrest occurring in Delhi.
Wadkute, representing the Marathwada region, was elected to the upper house this past April.
aiContextParagraph: Ramrao Wadkute, a Member of Parliament representing the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in the Rajya Sabha, has died following a cardiac arrest in New Delhi. A prominent figure from the Parbhani district within the Marathwada region of Maharashtra, his political career saw him ascend to national legislative responsibilities earlier this year. According to reports from multiple news outlets, he was elected to the Rajya Sabha in April 2026. His sudden passing has been acknowledged by colleagues and officials as a significant loss for the party's regional representation. The news of his death was confirmed across major media platforms, noting that he had been in the capital for parliamentary duties when the medical emergency occurred. No further details regarding his health history or memorial arrangements have been released by officials at this time.
whyItIsViral: The death of a sitting parliamentarian has been covered by three independent news outlets with consistent reporting across major national media channels.
